notes.title: Product Update V1.5.1
notes.content:
Latest update addresses the issues with profile saves that was introduced in a previous update. The original engine the game was developed in is currently obsolete so we had to update the entire game to a newer version of the engine which required quite a bit of re-coding for various parts of the game. 

 This on top of our time mostly being taken up by another one of our projects is the reason for the long delay getting this update out. If you encounter and bugs we may have missed resulting from the engine update please report it to Admin@endlessfluff.com . Again we apologize for the delay getting this update out.

notes.title: Legend of Fae Product Update v1.5.0
notes.content:
Update v1.5.0 is an engine update that fixes a number of start up issues and in-game crashes on many machines. 

Old save files will not be compatible with this update. For users who did not have any issues with the original version and wish to continue playing with their old saves, you can access the old version by doing the following...

-Right click "Legend of Fae" in your Steam library
-Click Properties
-Click the BETAS tab
-Select old_version from the drop down list

That should set your version of the game to the original build.
